title: Quick Same Day Focaccia
description: A quick homemade focaccia with a crisp olive oil crust and a soft, airy interior. Ready in about an hour—perfect when you don't have time for an overnight rise.
steps: In a large bowl, whisk together the warm water, yeast, honey (if using), salt, and olive oil.
Add the flour and mix until no dry flour remains. The dough should be very sticky.
Cover and let the dough rest in a warm place for 20 minutes.
With wet hands, perform one round of stretch-and-folds by pulling each side of the dough toward the center.
Cover and rest for another 15 minutes.
Generously oil a 9×13-inch (23×33 cm) baking tray with olive oil.
Transfer the dough to the tray and gently stretch it toward the edges. If it resists, let it rest for 5 minutes before stretching again.
Cover and proof for 15–20 minutes until noticeably puffy.
Drizzle generously with olive oil and dimple the dough deeply with well-oiled fingertips.
Top with rosemary, cherry tomatoes, olives, flaky sea salt, or your favorite toppings.
Bake in a preheated 425°F (220°C) oven for 22–25 minutes, or until deeply golden with crisp edges.
Cool for at least 10 minutes before slicing.
notes: Bread flour produces the best chew and oven spring.
Using warm water and a warm proofing environment is essential for a successful one-hour focaccia.
Honey is optional but helps the dough rise more quickly.
Don't be afraid to use plenty of olive oil—it creates the classic crispy crust.
For an even softer crumb, substitute up to half of the bread flour with all-purpose flour.
This quick version is excellent for sandwiches, garlic bread, or dipping into soups and olive oil.
